grades.rationale: The YAML preserves rule codes via by_rule/by_severity maps and tool-reported line-capable tools ran ok (ruff, bandit, pyright), though by_rule maps are empty because counts are zero; structural counts like complexipy.max=18 and vulture variable=1 are traceable to tool outputs.

Severity distributions are uninflated — bandit by_severity all zero, pip_audit shows 0 critical/high/medium/low with 36 unknown (honest labeling rather than inflating), and ruff security=0; the honest 'unknown' bucket for pip-audit shows restraint.

Covers correctness/style/security/complexity/modernization (ruff), security (bandit), complexity (radon+complexipy), maintainability (radon.mi), dead code (vulture), deps (pip-audit), secrets (detect_secrets), typing (pyright ok); mypy and ty are not_installed but pyright covers the typing lens.
Every count is derivable from a tool with status=ok, and the report cleanly distinguishes not_installed (mypy, ty) from ok status, with no counts appearing for errored tools.
Per the adaptation note, N/A for this format — graded 2 by default, though complexipy.over_threshold_15=2 and vulture dead_items=1 do pin fix direction implicitly.

Clean-pass evidence is strong: radon.cc.total_functions=39, complexipy.total_functions=31, pyright.files_analyzed=16, vulture identified 1 variable, proving tools reached real code; however by_rule maps are empty so no rule-code grounding for the complexipy over-threshold or vulture finding.

Full threshold+measurement coverage: complexipy max=18 with over_threshold_15=2, radon.cc.max=10 with over_threshold_10=0, radon.mi.min=52.47 with under_20=0, halstead.max_volume=526.1 with functions_over_1000_volume=0, plus CC and MI distribution breakdowns.
Per adaptation note, report does not editorialize; ruff by_category.style=0 and no prose commentary appears anywhere in the YAML.

Strong clean-axis evidence: radon.cc.distribution {A:36, B:3, C-F:0}, radon.mi.distribution {A:15, B:0, C:0}, bandit.total=0 cross-confirmed by ruff security=0, detect_secrets.new_since_baseline=0 — every clean axis is explicitly visible in distributions.
